system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning Workload Identity Federation for a GitHub Actions workflow that needs to deploy Cloud Run services.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning Workload Identity Federation for a GitHub Actions workflow that needs to deploy Cloud Run services.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
  - name: github-oidc-provider
    type: iam.v1.OidcProvider
    properties:
      issuerUri: https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
      audiences:
        - https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com

  - name: workload-identity-pool
    type: iam.v1.WorkloadIdentityPool
    properties:
      workloadIdentityPoolId: github-actions-pool

  - name: workload-identity-pool-provider
    type: iam.v1.WorkloadIdentityPoolProvider
    properties:
      workloadIdentityPoolId: $(ref.workload-identity-pool.name)
      oidcProviderId: $(ref.github-oidc-provider.name)
      attributeNameMapping:
        google.subject: assertion.sub
        attribute.repository-owner: assertion.repository_owner
        attribute.repository-name: assertion.repository
        attribute.workflow-name: assertion.workflow
        attribute.job-name: assertion.job

  - name: cloud-run-service-account
    type: iam.v1.ServiceAccount
    properties:
      accountId: cloud-run-deployer
      displayName: Cloud Run Deployer

  - name: cloud-run-service-account-iam-policy
    type: iam.v1.Policy
    properties:
      bindings:
        - role: roles/run.serviceAgent
          members:
            - serviceAccount:$(ref.cloud-run-service-account.email)
        - role: roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser
          members:
            - serviceAccount:$(ref.cloud-run-service-account.email)

  - name: workload-identity-binding
    type: iam.v1.IamPolicy
    properties:
      bindings:
        - role: roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser
          members:
            - serviceAccount:$(ref.cloud-run-service-account.email)
      resource: $(ref.workload-identity-pool.name)
